text:
I see you have a concerning rash and some recent health changes; can you tell me exactly where the rash started and how it has spread since then? 

Also, have you experienced any fever, weight loss, or night sweats recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. He does not recall being exposed to any new environmental stimuli such as detergents or plants like poison ivy. He mentions he recently started seeing a primary care provider for arthritis management and a new onset cough.

speaker: Doctor
text: That onset overnight is unusual for typical inflammatory arthritis flares; have you noticed any joint pain, swelling, or morning stiffness in addition to the cough? I also need to see the rash to determine its pattern, so please describe any joint symptoms you are feeling right now.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rash on the upper half of the back. I also have Concern over sudden onset, Recent cough, Unaware of exposure to new environmental stimuli, Mucositis.
